metadata.name: Diatom Composition and Environmental Data from AMK75-6150
metadata.description: This dataset contains diatom composition and environmental data from a single event (AMK75-6150) at a specific location (74.78 N, 8.44 E) with a depth of -3013 meters. The data includes counts of various diatom species, categorized by temperature preference and habitat, along with sediment depth, age, and elevation measurements.
